text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard Нарита Брайан tries,
she can't
envision winning against
Симболи Рудольф. She
continues to
struggle through this darkness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She reveals everything on her mind, and
I answer
her with an unwavering faith
that she can win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing that, Нарита Брайан regains

composure. She seems to remember that
I've
always believed in her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, at a press conference before the
Japan
Cup, Нарита Брайан announces her
intention to
defeat the Emperor, and
gives Симболи Рудольф a
firm handshake.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
